# HELLFALL Gate 2 blockout - placement rationale (REQ-G2-002..005)

**Data:** `Data/blockout.json` - GENERATED by `Docs/blockout/blockout.build.mjs` (edit the script, never the JSON; `node Docs/blockout/blockout.build.mjs` regenerates it and refuses to write on any placement failure; `node Docs/blockout/blockout.tables.mjs` then regenerates section 6 below and the manifest column). Schema: `Docs/FLOORPLAN-SCHEMA.md` "Blockout data" (asset_slots / props / characters / pickups / demons / triggers / backdrop / dwell), checked by `Tools/validate_blockout.mjs`; sizes from the REQ-G2-001 Blender audit `Docs/audit/blender_audit_2026-09-07.json`; thresholds from `Data/greybox_style.json : blockout.rules`, `Data/metrics.json` and `Data/movement.json`. The approved Gate 1 floor (`Data/floorplan.json`, 37 rooms) is untouched: every blockout sits INSIDE an approved room rect.

Plan space throughout: `x` right, `y` down toward the window wall, cm; yaw 0 = +x, 90 = +y. Room rects are interior clear dimensions (the coordinates quoted below are those rects).

**Read this first - the guard is back in the corridor (lead decision 2026-09-07):** the **dead security guard lies along `corridor_main`'s north wall** as REQ-G2-003 / `note_guard` read (x 4300-4461, flush at y 1750, 78 deep), the **shotgun beside his hand** (x 4470-4590, y 1770-1792) with its halo flush on the wall, both inside `sc_guard_shotgun` and clear of `cp_corridor_post_pickup` - the scene rect and the checkpoint have their content. The audited mesh is a seated slump 78 x 161 x 82, so past him the corridor keeps 202 of its 280: under the 216 prop rule, over the new **150 cm body waiver** (`greybox_style.json : blockout.rules.corridor_clear_min_past_body_cm` = capsule diameter 72 + the 78 body - "a body you step past, not architecture"), enforced by both checkers for CHARACTERS only (props keep 216) and printed on every PASS line. Rob may still move him to the elevator alcove (section 7 deviation 1, Q1). Each demon cylinder now stands on its audited footprint slab (`Demon_<id>_footprint`, 162 x 204 / 208 x 83 x 10 cm, no collision, facing the player approach). Everything else follows the approved notes or the audit.

## 1. What was placed, and the rules it was placed under

Every item is a labelled box (`<label> w x d x h`) with collision, except: demons (cylinders, no collision, so the lane checks stay honest; each carries `footprint_cm`, the audited wing span, which the generator draws as `Demon_<id>_footprint` - a translucent no-collision 10 cm slab w x d under the cylinder, yawed so the mesh faces the encounter's `player_approach` with the wing span across that facing, tint `blockout_demon_footprint`; the label reads "DEMON #2 (SK_CrimsonHellfiend) 300 cm, footprint 208 x 83"; no corridor / lane / overlap rule counts the slab), the shotgun's 160 x 62 x 60 halo box, the two encounter trigger volumes, the dwell volume and the fire backdrop (translucent / emissive, no collision). Tints by kind from `greybox_style.json : blockout.kind_tints` (furniture / fixture / door / rack / generic), plus `blockout_character`, `blockout_pickup` + `pickup_halo`, `blockout_demon`, `trigger_volume` / `dwell_volume` (0.1 opacity - they stand in the sightline strip above the eye line), `backdrop_fire`.

Rules enforced by the generator's self-check AND by `Tools/validate_blockout.mjs` (same maths - oriented footprints, separating-axis overlap, 0.5 cm tolerance so flush contact is allowed):

| rule | value | source |
|---|---|---|
| footprint inside its room, distance to walls | >= 5 cm, or exactly flush when `mount: wall` / `contact: wall:<side>` | `blockout.rules.wall_margin_cm` |
| door swing zone kept clear | 120 deep x max(120, opening width) inside EVERY room side of every door / open / locked door / duct mouth (76 zones). **Waiver:** a `door` prop flush on the wall INSIDE a `locked_door` opening's span is that opening's shut door - nothing swings - so that one zone is waived for it (the two `SM_ClosedDoor` boxes) | `blockout.rules.door_swing_cm` |
| the first move | player start (5210, 150) -> duct mouth (5210, 430), swept by the capsule radius 36: nothing within it (nearest: the seated man, 63) | REQ-G2-002 AC3, `movement.player.capsule_radius_cm` |
| encounter lanes | retreat + strafe segments from `floorplan.json encounters`, widened by the player capsule radius 36 | `movement.player.capsule_radius_cm` |
| clear discs | checkpoints r 60, player start r 36, demon spawn capsules r 45 / 60 | `blockout.rules`, encounters |
| scene rects | a PROP may lie in a scene rect ONLY when the scene is kind `scene` and the prop's note names it - the prop IS the tableau (`board_table` + chairs in `sc_boardroom`, `bullpen_island_m` + chairs in `sc_bullpen_massacre`); monster / ambush / pickup / reveal floors stay open; characters / pickups inside a rect are WARNs | schema rule |
| money-shot strip | door centre -> window centre, +-90, in `ceo_office` | `blockout.rules.sightline_half_width_cm` |
| corridors | widest free gap ACROSS the corridor at every station >= 216 (3 x capsule diameter), items on opposite walls at one station narrowing it together; items <= 40 high (`max_step_height_cm`) are stepped over (the 6 cm shotgun in `corridor_main` is the one item that relies on it); **body waiver (lead decision 2026-09-07):** a station narrowed ONLY by characters against a wall (pose seated / prone / slumped, `contact: wall:<side>`) needs 150 instead - capsule diameter 72 + the 78 cm body, "a body you step past, not architecture"; a prop at the station (alone or beside a body) keeps 216; both checkers apply it and print every waived station (`corridor_main 202 past guard (body waiver 150)`) | metrics derived rule, `movement.json`; `blockout.rules.corridor_clear_min_past_body_cm` |
| seated / slumped bodies | back face exactly on the contact surface (wall face or prop face), facing away from it | REQ-G2-003 AC2 |
| chokepoint on the demon's path | >= 280 (corridor width) at the dividing wall's free end; the validator's 7b widest-route check reports demon_1 450 / demon_2 310 | REQ-G2-004 |
| eye line | nothing south of the CEO door wall taller than the standing eye height 166 | REQ-G2-005 |
| backdrop | fills the glass from the doorway AND, from every dwell-rect corner at eye height, the 90 deg FOV pitched a full vertical FOV (58.7 deg at 16:9) down or up lands on the plane | REQ-G2-005, `movement.player.fov_horizontal_deg` |

At Demon #2 he has 7 m of retreat to the west wall with the desk (110 tall) on his left at y 4304-4496 - a low obstacle he can round, never a wall - the two guest chairs (90 tall) beyond it and the couch set in the far SW corner; the demon has 309 cm between the wall's free end and that desk, and its 208 cm wings pass with a metre to spare.

## 5. Money-shot check (REQ-G2-005)

Sightline strip x 3050-3230 (door centre 3140 +-90), y 4000-4780: **nothing in it**; nearest blockout the CEO desk's east corner at 53.9. From the doorway (eye (3140, 3990) z 166):

- **CEO desk** `SM_ReceptionDesk` 157 x 157 x 110 at (2900, 4400), yaw 15 (angled toward the glass): footprint x 2804-2996, y 4304-4496 - west of the strip, 54 south of the retreat lane, 13 x below the eye line. Projected onto the glass it hides only the bottom ~39 cm over x ~2616-2915 (window sill 40, head 300: the upper 220 cm of glass are untouched).
- **Guest chairs** 50 x 50 x 90 at (2700, 4350) and (2700, 4450), west of the desk: below the eye line, west of the strip, 39 south of the retreat lane.
- **Dead CEO** `SM_CeoDead` 170 x 105 x 48 at (2900, 4558.5), lying along x between the desk (y 4496) and the dwell rect (y 4630, 19 clear): hidden from the doorway by the desk - the player finds him walking in, as the note intends ("slumped behind it").
- **Couch set** `SM_CeoCouchCoffeeTable` 280 x 254 x 80 at (2545, 4648): x 2405-2685, y 4521-4775 - the SW corner in front of the west glass panes, 155 west of the dwell rect, 235 south of the retreat lane. Its 80 back hides the bottom 40 cm of the west 280 cm of glass (about 3 % of the glass area), all below the eye line.
- **Credenza** 200 x 40 x 200 on the north (door) wall at x 2450-2650 and the **side console** 90 x 35 x 80 on the east wall at y 4005-4095: behind / beside the viewer, clear of the trigger strip (y 4100-4200) and the door zone.
- **Bar cabinet** 150 x 45 x 100 on the east wall at y 4450-4600: inside the demon pocket, screened by the dividing wall.
- The dividing wall itself (frozen Gate 1) still hides glass x 3441-3880 from the door centre (`FLOORPLAN.md` 7, Q6): net 71 % of the FOV; `check_manifest` measures the raw 86.3 deg = 96 %.
- **The CEO door** is told by `SM_BrokenDoor` lying flat in RECEPTION 100 cm east of the doorway (x 3297-3503, y 3852-3958): torn off and thrown, burst open from within. No `SM_ClosedDoor` stands in the office or beside the doorway (the mesh is a closed panel with casing, which would read as a second door); nothing of it is inside the +-90 strip.
- Dwell volume over `money_shot.dwell_rect` (x 2840-3440, y 4630-4780) 200 tall in the `dwell_volume` tint (0.1 opacity - it stands in the strip above the eye line, so the glass is not seen through a wash); both trigger volumes 220 tall in `trigger_volume`.
- **Backdrop** 12000 x 5000 plane 800 beyond the glass (y 5600), bottom at z -2500: sized for the DWELL rect, not just the doorway. From the doorway it needs x 1623-4657, z -92..441 (covered). From each dwell corner at eye height the 90 deg FOV, pitched a full vertical FOV (58.7 deg at 16:9) down or up, needs x 1870-4410 and z -2092..2424 - covered, so leaning in at the glass to look down at the fire never shows the void under the plane. Rays through the glass EDGES from the dwell rect's inner corners reach x -3285..9565, past the plane's -2860..9140: those grazing looks along the glass need the sky sphere REQ-G2-005 allows as the alternative (Q12). The plane is scenery outside the boundary shell (check_manifest: "1 backdrop beyond the shell").

Lead deviation to flag: the assignment text said "CEO desk ... east of the axis"; the approved `note_ceo_desk` marker says (2900, 4400) WEST of the axis, and the east side north of the dividing wall is the trigger strip + strafe lane while south of it is the demon's pocket - so the desk stays west, per the approved plan (Q6 below).

## 7. Deviations from the Gate 2 brief and the Gate 1 notes (lead to confirm)

1. **Guard in the corridor with a 150 cm body waiver (REQ-G2-003, `note_guard`, `sc_guard_shotgun`, checklist 4) - LEAD DECISION 2026-09-07, replacing the first cut's break-room placement.** The brief wants him along `corridor_main`'s north wall (x 4300-4480) with the shotgun beside him at (4540, 1820). The Blender audit shows a seated slump (78 across, legs 161 out, 82 tall): along the wall he leaves 202 of the 280 (legs across would leave 119), below the 216 prop minimum and too tall (82 > 40) to be stepped over - so the first cut moved him into the break room. The lead ruled the spec placement stands and the 216 rule gets a CHARACTER-only waiver: `greybox_style.json : blockout.rules.corridor_clear_min_past_body_cm` = 150 (capsule diameter 72 + the 78 body - a body you step past, not architecture), applied by the build script's self-check and by `validate_blockout.mjs` to stations narrowed only by seated / prone / slumped characters with a wall contact, and printed on every PASS line. He now lies at x 4300-4461, flush on the north wall (y 1750-1828), the shotgun at x 4470-4590, y 1770-1792 (its 160 x 62 halo flush at y 1750-1812), both clear of the assoc_4 door zone (x <= 4300), the break-room door zone (x >= 4680), the bullpen opening zone (x 3850-4130, y >= 1910) and the `cp_corridor_post_pickup` disc ((4400, 1890) r 60: 62 and 98 cm away). Both lie inside `sc_guard_shotgun` (x 4460-4660, y 1780-1930) as its content - the two "in scene rect (pickup)" WARNs both checkers print by design - so the scene rect and the checkpoint now have what the plan promised. The box carries the mesh's leg axis ALONG the wall (schema `w` 161, `d` 78 with `contact: wall:north`); Gate 4 poses the mesh shoulder-to-the-wall or re-authors it prone. Rob may still move him to the elevator alcove (Q1).
2. **Sizes follow the audit, not `BUILD.md` 5.1** (section 2): desks 157 x 157 (chair + monitor baked in), kitchen set 160 x 114 with two chairs, vanity 246, wall-hung toilets, couch set as one 280 x 254 L-mesh, elevator 134 wide on the 200 blocker, closed door 102 x 17 x 220.

## 9. Regeneration loop

1. Edit the placement table in `Docs/blockout/blockout.build.mjs` (one line per item: `P(...)` floor prop, `W(...)` wall prop, `C(...)` / `CW(...)` character, `K(...)` pickup, the `KIT` sizes, the `BACKDROP` block) and run `node Docs/blockout/blockout.build.mjs` - it refuses to write `Data/blockout.json` while any rule in section 1 fails and prints the offending item; its WARN lines are the tableau props in their scene rects.
2. `node Tools/validate_blockout.mjs Data/blockout.json` (the team's independent check of the same rules plus the schema, the Blender-audit cross-check of `asset_slots`, the asset coverage, the pickup-scene content check and the 7b widest-route sweep).
3. `node Docs/blockout/blockout.tables.mjs` (rewrites section 6 of this file from the JSON) and `node Docs/blockout/blockout.tables.mjs --manifest` (rewrites the "Blockout (Gate 2)" column of `Docs/ASSET-MANIFEST.md`); then re-read sections 3-5 and 7-8 for prose that quotes numbers.
4. `Tools\test_dry_run.ps1` - steps 6a-6d rebuild the manifest with the blockouts and check overlaps, room containment, enclosure and the money shot.
5. `Tools\ue\run_editor_script.ps1 -Script build_greybox.py` rebuilds `/Game/Maps/L_ExecutiveFloor` with the `Blockout/*` folders (lead only).
